issues.legal_issue: The limitation period for seeking a reference concerning an acquisition award begins when the affected applicant has actual or constructive knowledge of the award if the applicant was not present or represented when it was made and was not served notice of it.
material_facts: The applicants were not present when the award was made and had not been served notice of it.
There was no evidence that notice of the award had been served on the applicants.
The applicants’ assertion that they learned of the award when compensation was paid in July 1988 was not challenged.
They applied for a reference on September 22, 1988, within six months of learning of the award.
The High Court held that the application was time-barred by counting from the date the award was declared.
issues.conclusion: The application was within time because it was made within six months of the applicants’ knowledge of the award. The finding that it was time-barred was set aside, and the appeals were remitted to the High Court for decision on the merits.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 18(2)(b) of the Land Acquisition Act, where an applicant was not present or represented when the award was made and was not served notice under Section 12(2), the limitation period runs from the date the applicant had actual or constructive knowledge of the award, rather than mechanically from the date it was declared. The Court applied Raja Harish Chandra Raj Singh v. The Deputy Land Acquisition Officer and another, AIR 1961 SC 1500, which held that knowledge or communication of the award is essential and that the date of the award, for this purpose, is when it is communicated or becomes known actually or constructively.

predicates.reference_request_concerning_acquisition: The applicant sought a reference concerning an award made in an acquisition proceeding.
predicates.applicant_absent_or_unrepresented_when_a: The applicant was neither present nor represented when the award was made.
predicates.applicant_not_served_award_notice: The applicant was not served notice of the award.
predicates.application_filed_within_six_months_of_k: The applicant filed the reference request within six months after gaining actual or constructive knowledge of the award.

issues.definition: When an applicant seeking a reference concerning an acquisition award was absent or unrepresented when it was made, received no notice of it, and applied within six months of learning of it, the application is within time.
